# Hive inspection checklist

Laminated copy lives in the bee box with the smoker. Four hives at the top of the orchard: Primrose (H1), Bramble (H2), Hazel (H3), Ivy (H4). My son-in-law says it looks like his [[Code review checklist]] at work, which I take as a compliment to both of us.

## Before opening

- [ ] Warm enough? 15°C or above, not raining, not after 5 pm
- [ ] Smoker lit with hessian and dry grass, puffing cool white smoke
- [ ] Suit zipped, gloves on, wellies tucked
- [ ] Hive tool, spare frame, queen clip, notebook and pencil
- [ ] Record card for the hive in the lid

## Going through

- [ ] Gentle puff at the entrance, wait one minute
- [ ] Lift the crown board slowly, note temper (1 calm to 5 cross)
- [ ] Supers off and onto the upturned roof
- [ ] First frame out from the wall side, then work across

## What to look for (the five questions)

- [ ] Is there room? Brood box more than 7 of 11 frames full, add a super
- [ ] Is the queen laying? Eggs standing upright in cells = laid within 3 days
- [ ] Is the brood healthy? Pearly white larvae, even capping, no sunken or holed cappings
- [ ] Any queen cells? Count, note where. Play cups don't count. See [[Swarm catching]] if charged
- [ ] Enough stores? At least 2 frames of sealed honey, more from August

## Also check

- [ ] Varroa board count, every 2 weeks in season, numbers into [[Varroa mite treatment]]
- [ ] Queen's mark visible? Colour per year in [[Queen marking colors]]
- [ ] Chalkbrood mummies on the floor
- [ ] Wasps at the entrance from August

## After closing

- [ ] Record card filled in
- [ ] Smoker out in the bucket of sand, never in the car
- [ ] Wash gloves in washing soda if it was a cross hive

## Season dates 2025

First full inspection 6 April (Primrose, Hazel). Weekly until 31 July, fortnightly in August, last full one 14 September.
